epay.text: You must make your deposits electronically if at least one of these applies: you withheld a total of $10,000 or more in Minnesota income tax during the last 12-month period ending June 30; you are required to electronically pay any other Minnesota business tax; you use a payroll service company.

deposits.interpretation: Minnesota withholding is deposited by the FEDERAL schedule when the employer withheld MORE than $1,500 of Minnesota tax in the previous quarter. SEMIWEEKLY (federal semiweekly and over $1,500): paydays Wednesday to Friday are due the Wednesday after, Saturday to Tuesday the Friday after. MONTHLY (federal monthly and over $1,500): by the 15th of the month. Minnesota did NOT adopt the federal one-day $100,000 rule. QUARTERLY: an employer who withheld $1,500 or less in the previous quarter AND filed the previous quarter's return on time may deposit the whole quarter's tax by April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31. ANNUAL: an annual filer (prior-year withholding of $500 or less) pays on January 31 with the return, but must deposit whenever the year's total exceeds $500, by the last day of the following month (that interim rule is NOT modelled). Because the schedule above $1,500 depends on the FEDERAL schedule, the look-back amount can only derive 'quarterly' ($1,500 or less); for anything above that the assigned frequency ('semiweekly' or 'monthly', matching the federal schedule) must be supplied, and the engine refuses to guess. Quarterly returns are due April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31 even if all tax was deposited or none withheld; seasonal businesses may file only their quarters.

lookback.description: Minnesota income tax withheld in the previous quarter (quarterly only if $1,500 or less and the previous return was on time)

returns.name: Minnesota withholding quarterly return (Worksheet A; filed in e-Services)
contents: Due April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31; filed for all four quarters even if no tax was withheld or all of it was deposited.
Reports wages, number of employees, tax withheld, deposits and credits; an overpayment carries forward or is refunded.
Seasonal businesses that withhold in the same up-to-three quarters each year may qualify to file only those quarters.

returns.name: Minnesota annual withholding return (Worksheet B; filed in e-Services)
contents: Annual filers (prior-year withholding of $500 or less) file by January 31, after the W-2s and 1099s are complete, with the year's wages, employees and tax withheld.

returns.name: Quarterly wage detail report and payment
contents: Wage detail reports must be received by the department on or before April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31; a weekend or legal holiday moves the date to the following business day.
Employers with no employees submit a Zero Wage Report; the payment must be received by the same date.
